    embed-resources: true
    page-layout: full

execute:

```{r data-prep}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(jsonlite)
})

# All normalisation is handled by 01_data_cleaning_script.R
# This chunk reads the pre-cleaned CSV and injects it as JSON
df      <- read_csv("../01_data/6.4_cleaned_extraction_data.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
json_out <- toJSON(df, na = "null", auto_unbox = TRUE)
```

```{r inject-data, results='asis'}
cat(paste0('<script id="course-json">const COURSES=', json_out, ';</script>\n'))
```

```{=html}
<style>
/* ── Reset Quarto chrome ── */
#title-block-header, .quarto-title { display:none !important; }
body { background:#f0f4f8; margin:0; padding:0; font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif; }
.page-full > .content { padding:0 !important; max-width:none !important; }

/* ── App shell ── */
#app { display:grid; grid-template-columns:270px 1fr; min-height:100vh; }

/* ── Filter panel ── */
#filter-panel {
  background:#fff; border-right:1px solid #dde3ec;
  padding:0; position:sticky; top:0; height:100vh; overflow-y:auto;
}
#filter-header {
  background:#1e4d8c; color:#fff; padding:14px 16px;
  font-size:15px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.02em;
}
#filter-header small { display:block; font-size:11px; font-weight:400; opacity:.8; margin-top:2px; }
#search-box {
  width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; padding:8px 10px; border:1px solid #cdd5e0;
  border-radius:4px; font-size:13px; margin:0;
}
#search-wrap { padding:10px 12px 6px; border-bottom:1px solid #eef0f5; }
#clear-btn {
  margin:6px 12px 0; padding:4px 12px; font-size:12px; background:#f5f7fa;
  border:1px solid #cdd5e0; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer; color:#555;
}
#clear-btn:hover { background:#e0e4ea; }

/* ── Facet sections ── */
.facet { border-bottom:1px solid #eef0f5; }
.facet-title {
  padding:8px 12px; font-size:12px; font-weight:700; color:#1e4d8c;
  text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.06em; cursor:pointer;
  display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;
  user-select:none;
}
.facet-title:hover { background:#f5f7fb; }
.facet-title .toggle { font-size:10px; color:#999; }
.facet-body { padding:2px 12px 8px; }
.facet-body.collapsed { display:none; }
.facet-option { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; padding:3px 0; }
.facet-option label { font-size:13px; color:#333; cursor:pointer; flex:1; }
.facet-option .cnt { font-size:11px; color:#888; }
.facet-option input[type=checkbox] { accent-color:#1e4d8c; cursor:pointer; }
/* ── Results panel ── */
#results-panel { padding:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; }
#results-header {
  background:#fff; border-bottom:1px solid #dde3ec; padding:12px 20px;
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px; position:sticky; top:0; z-index:10;
}
#results-header h1 { font-size:18px; font-weight:700; color:#1e4d8c; margin:0; flex:1; }
#result-count { font-size:13px; color:#555; white-space:nowrap; }
#sort-select { font-size:13px; border:1px solid #cdd5e0; border-radius:4px; padding:4px 8px; }

/* ── Card grid ── */
#card-grid {
  padding:16px 20px;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill, minmax(340px, 1fr));
  gap:14px;
  align-content:start;
}
.course-card {
  background:#fff; border:1px solid #dde3ec; border-radius:8px;
  padding:14px 16px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px;
  transition:box-shadow .15s, border-color .15s;
}
.course-card:hover { box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(30,77,140,.12); border-color:#a0b4cc; }
.card-top { display:flex; gap:5px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
.card-title { margin:0; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; line-height:1.4; }
.card-title a { color:#1e4d8c; text-decoration:none; }
.card-title a:hover { text-decoration:underline; }
.card-provider { font-size:12px; color:#666; }
.card-enrol { font-size:12px; color:#2d6a4f; }
.card-enrol-closed { color:#999; }
.card-meta { font-size:12px; color:#555; }
.card-tools { font-size:11px; color:#777; }
.no-results { grid-column:1/-1; text-align:center; padding:60px 20px; color:#666; }
.no-results h2 { color:#999; }

/* ── Badges ── */
.badge {
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:4px;
  background:#f1f5f9; color:#334155;
  padding:3px 9px; border-radius:12px;
  font-size:11px; font-weight:600; white-space:nowrap;
}
.badge-icon { font-size:12px; line-height:1; }
.badge-label {
  display:inline-flex; align-items:baseline; gap:4px;
  background:#f1f5f9; border-radius:12px; padding:2px 9px 3px;
  font-size:11px; font-weight:600; white-space:nowrap;
}
.badge-label .cat { color:#94a3b8; font-size:9px; font-weight:600; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.03em; }
.badge-label .val { color:#334155; }
/* Format */
.badge-format { background:#f1f5f9; color:#475569; }
/* Research oriented */
.badge-research-high     { background:#d1fae5; color:#065f46; }
.badge-research-moderate { background:#e0f2fe; color:#075985; }
.badge-research-low      { background:#f1f5f9; color:#475569; }
.badge-research-no       { background:#fef2f2; color:#991b1b; }
/* Hands on coding */

</style>

<div id="app">
  <!-- FILTER SIDEBAR -->
  <nav id="filter-panel">
    <div id="filter-header">
      Course Finder
    </div>
    <div id="search-wrap">
      <input id="search-box" type="search" placeholder="Search courses, providers, topics…">
    </div>
    <button id="clear-btn" onclick="clearAll()">Clear all filters</button>
    <div id="facet-container"></div>
  </nav>

  <!-- RESULTS PANEL -->
  <main id="results-panel">
    <div id="results-header">
      <h1>Advanced Analytics &amp; AI Courses for Health Researchers</h1>
      <span id="result-count">Loading…</span>
      <select id="sort-select" onchange="render()">
        <option value="name">Sort: Name A–Z</option>
        <option value="level">Sort: Level</option>
        <option value="health">Sort: Health Relevance</option>
        <option value="provider">Sort: Provider</option>
      </select>
    </div>
    <div id="card-grid"></div>
  </main>
</div>

<script>
// ── Filter definitions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// tool_domains uses multi-value matching (semicolon-separated) — see matches()
const FACETS = [
  { key: 'primary_language', label: 'Primary Language', multi: false,
    options: ['Python','R','SQL','No Programming','Mixed','Julia','SAS','MATLAB','Other','Unknown'] },
  { key: 'level', label: 'Level', multi: false,
    options: ['Beginner','Intermediate','Advanced','Expert','Unknown'] },
  { key: 'cost_model', label: 'Cost / Access', multi: false,
    options: ['Free','Free to Audit','Freemium','Institutional','Subscription','Paid','Unknown'] },
  { key: 'format', label: 'Format', multi: false,
    options: ['Short Course','MOOC','Workshop','Specialization','Prof. Certificate','Webinar','Interactive','Video Course','Other'] },
  { key: 'delivery_platform', label: 'Delivery Platform', multi: false,
    options: ['Online','Blended','In-person','Other'] },
  { key: 'learning_pace', label: 'Learning Pace', multi: false,
    options: ['Self-paced','Instructor-paced','Cohort-based','Hybrid','Intensive','Mentor-led','Other'] },
  { key: 'enrolment_status', label: 'Enrolment Status', multi: false,
    options: ['Open enrolment','Scheduled cohort — open','Scheduled cohort — closed','One-time event — passed','Not stated'] },
  { key: 'hands_on_coding', label: 'Hands-on Coding', multi: false,
    options: ['Extensive','Moderate','Light','Conceptual / No coding','Yes (level unspecified)','Unknown'] },
  { key: 'health_domain_relevance', label: 'Health Research Context', multi: false,
    options: ['High','Medium','Low','No'] },
  { key: 'tool_domains', label: 'Tool Domain', multi: true,
    options: [
      'Programming & Environments',
      'Analysis Methods',
      'Conversational AI & Coding Co-pilots',
      'ML Frameworks & Methods',
      'Domain-Specific Tools',
      'No Code / Low Code'
    ]},
  { key: 'research_workflow_relevance', label: 'Research Oriented', multi: false,
    options: ['High','Moderate','Low','No','Unknown'] }
];

// ── State ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const state = { search:'' };
FACETS.forEach(f => { state[f.key] = new Set(); });

// ── Build filter UI ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function buildFilters() {
  const container = document.getElementById('facet-container');

  // Precompute counts — multi-value fields need special handling
  const totals = {};
  FACETS.forEach(f => {
    totals[f.key] = {};
    f.options.forEach(opt => {
      if (f.multi) {
        totals[f.key][opt] = COURSES.filter(c => {
          const vals = (c[f.key] || '').split('; ');
          return vals.includes(opt);
        }).length;
      } else {
        totals[f.key][opt] = COURSES.filter(c => c[f.key] === opt).length;
      }
    });
  });

  FACETS.forEach((f, fi) => {
    const div = document.createElement('div');
    div.className = 'facet';
    const collapsed = fi > 3;
    div.innerHTML = `
      <div class="facet-title" onclick="toggleFacet(this)">
        ${f.label} <span class="toggle">${collapsed ? '▶' : '▼'}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="facet-body${collapsed ? ' collapsed' : ''}">
        ${f.options.map(opt => {
          const cnt = totals[f.key][opt] || 0;
          if (cnt === 0) return '';
          const id = 'cb-' + f.key + '-' + opt.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi,'_');
          return '<div class="facet-option">' +
            '<input type="checkbox" id="' + id + '" value="' + opt + '" ' +
            'data-key="' + f.key + '" onchange="toggleFilter(this)">' +
            '<label for="' + id + '">' + opt + '</label>' +
            '<span class="cnt">' + cnt + '</span>' +
            '</div>';
        }).join('')}
      </div>`;
    container.appendChild(div);
  });
}

function toggleFacet(el) {
  const body = el.nextElementSibling;
  const arrow = el.querySelector('.toggle');
  const isCollapsed = body.classList.contains('collapsed');
  body.classList.toggle('collapsed', !isCollapsed);
  arrow.textContent = isCollapsed ? '▼' : '▶';
}

// ── Filter logic ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function toggleFilter(cb) {
  const key = cb.dataset.key;
  const val = cb.value;
  if (cb.checked) state[key].add(val);
  else state[key].delete(val);
  render();
}

function clearAll() {
  FACETS.forEach(f => {
    state[f.key].clear();
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-key="' + f.key + '"]').forEach(cb => cb.checked = false);
  });
  state.search = '';
  document.getElementById('search-box').value = '';
  render();
}

function matches(c) {
  // Exclude one-time past events by default — these are genuinely dead listings.
  // Scheduled cohort — closed courses are still shown (they may reopen).
  const enrolFilter = state['enrolment_status'];
  if (c.enrolment_status === 'One-time event \u2014 passed' && !enrolFilter.has('One-time event \u2014 passed')) return false;
  // Text search across name, provider, topics, tools, and domains
  if (state.search) {
    const q = state.search.toLowerCase();
    const haystack = [c.course_name, c.provider, c.key_topics, c.primary_tools, c.tools_list, c.tool_domains]
      .filter(Boolean).join(' ').toLowerCase();
    if (!haystack.includes(q)) return false;
  }
  // Standard single-value facets
  for (const f of FACETS) {
    if (!state[f.key].size) continue;
    if (f.multi) {
      // tool_domains is semicolon-separated — match if any selected domain is present
      const vals = (c[f.key] || '').split('; ').map(v => v.trim());
      if (!vals.some(v => state[f.key].has(v))) return false;
    } else {
      if (!state[f.key].has(c[f.key])) return false;
    }
  }
  return true;
}

// ── Sorting ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const LEVEL_ORDER  = { Beginner:0, Intermediate:1, Advanced:2, Expert:3, Unknown:4 };
const HEALTH_ORDER = { High:0, Medium:1, Low:2, Yes:3, No:4, Unknown:5 };

function sortedCourses(arr) {
  const by = document.getElementById('sort-select').value;
  return [...arr].sort((a, b) => {
    if (by === 'level')    return (LEVEL_ORDER[a.level]                    ?? 9) - (LEVEL_ORDER[b.level]                    ?? 9);
    if (by === 'health')   return (HEALTH_ORDER[a.health_domain_relevance] ?? 9) - (HEALTH_ORDER[b.health_domain_relevance] ?? 9);
    if (by === 'provider') return (a.provider || '').localeCompare(b.provider || '');
    return (a.course_name || '').localeCompare(b.course_name || '');
  });
}

// ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function esc(s) {
  if (!s) return '';
  return s.replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;');
}
function trunc(s, n) { return s && s.length > n ? s.slice(0, n) + '…' : (s || ''); }

// ── Card rendering ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function cardHTML(c) {
  return '<div class="course-card">' +
    '<div class="card-top">' +
      '<span class="badge"><span class="badge-icon">📊</span>' + esc(c.level)  + '</span>' +
      '<span class="badge"><span class="badge-icon">💲</span>' + esc(c.cost_model) + '</span>' +
      '<span class="badge-label"><span class="cat">Platform</span><span class="val">' + esc(c.delivery_platform) + '</span></span>' +
      '<span class="badge-label"><span class="cat">Pace</span><span class="val">' + esc(c.learning_pace) + '</span></span>' +
    '</div>' +
    '<div class="card-title">' +
      (c.link
        ? '<a href="' + esc(c.link) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">' + esc(c.course_name) + '</a>'
        : esc(c.course_name)) +
    '</div>' +
    '<div class="card-provider">' + esc(c.provider) + '</div>' +
    (function() {
      const s = c.enrolment_status || '';
      if (s === 'Open enrolment') return '<div class="card-enrol">🔁 Enrol anytime</div>';
      if (s === 'Scheduled cohort \u2014 open')
        return '<div class="card-enrol">📅 ' + (c.next_start_date ? 'Starts ' + esc(c.next_start_date) : 'Open cohort') + '</div>';
      if (s === 'Scheduled cohort \u2014 closed') return '<div class="card-enrol card-enrol-closed">⛔ Enrolment closed</div>';
      if (s === 'One-time event \u2014 passed')   return '<div class="card-enrol card-enrol-closed">⛔ No longer available</div>';
      return '';
    })() +
    (c.duration ? '<div class="card-meta">⏱ ' + esc(c.duration) + '</div>' : '') +
    (c.primary_tools ? '<div class="card-tools">🛠 ' + esc(trunc(c.primary_tools, 80)) + '</div>' : '') +
  '</div>';
}

// ── Render ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function render() {
  const filtered = sortedCourses(COURSES.filter(matches));
  document.getElementById('result-count').textContent =
    filtered.length + ' of ' + COURSES.length + ' courses';
  const grid = document.getElementById('card-grid');
  if (filtered.length === 0) {
    grid.innerHTML = '<div class="no-results"><h2>No courses match</h2><p>Try adjusting your filters.</p></div>';
    return;
  }
  grid.innerHTML = filtered.map(c => cardHTML(c)).join('');
}

// ── Search ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
let searchTimer;
document.getElementById('search-box').addEventListener('input', e => {
  clearTimeout(searchTimer);
  searchTimer = setTimeout(() => { state.search = e.target.value.trim(); render(); }, 200);
});

// ── Init ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
buildFilters();
render();
</script>
```
